_readme: Known vulnerabilities that fleet.py checks every census against. When a big one hits the news, add an entry here (copy an existing one). 'fixed_in' maps a release branch to the first fixed version. 'branch_parts' is how many numbers make a branch: 2 means 8.4 for PHP, 1 means 26 for macOS. Anything older than 'unsupported_below' (but not older than 'affected_from') gets no fix and must be upgraded.

advisories.summary: Unauthenticated remote code execution and memory disclosure in the PHP engine (four bugs under two CVEs).
advisories.action: Update PHP, then restart every service that loads it (php-fpm, apache, etc.). If the server was reachable from outside since 2026-10-17, rotate its secrets.

advisories.summary: Out-of-bounds write in CoreGraphics; a malicious file can run code.
advisories.action: System Settings > General > Software Update. iPhones/iPads: iOS 26.7.1 or iOS 27.
